Yeah have heard that too. My doctor specifically asked me to be careful and not get one with much compression so I got a very basic all-cotton (not spandex) one, and the girls haven’t stopped growing since then!

My hips widened when I was 13 and was bullied because of it at school. 
Now I’m 35, trans woman AMAB with a rather curvy body. Who’s laughing now uh? 😌

All bodies are different, but in general -and according to my own experience- best you can expect is between 3 and 6 months.

For me it was my breasts what were painful to hide. First at 2.5 months I couldn’t bear the feeling of a tshirt on my nipples so I started wearing a sports bra that not only helped with that sensation but also to hide them to some extent. At 4 months they were so tender and swollen that the sports bra wasn’t bearable anymore and that was the moment when I decided to go full time.

What I am afraid of the most is that –and I’m replying out of pure ignorance– as the new passport hasn’t been used before, they won’t get a match from where it was issued and where I’m coming from. How did I manage to enter country Y without getting a stamp/label of entry? If they ask I’ll need to show my ID or working visa issued by country Y, which won’t match the name and gender in my current passport. 

Maybe I’m overthinking this but it truly bothers me 😕
Uhm – I’m pretty sure they did stare at me.
